title: Trained Tiny-Transformer Hybrid Dual-Clock Geo-RoPE and Google SLEEP Continual Learning Study
hypothesis: Training parameter-matched (~1.43M-param) causal transformers with Hybrid-Dual-Geo-RoPE (32-D fast token RoPE + 32-D Caelus geocentric physical torus from python/astroengine/) preserves intra-turn state tracking and post-sleep reset continuity while decisively beating Standard-RoPE and steelman Hybrid-Unix-Fourier-RoPE on OOD high-latitude solstice photoperiod generalization (Oslo 5.9h winter / 18.8h summer + NYC-to-Tokyo travel) and multi-week annual-wrap non-aliasing; and pairing Hybrid-Dual-Geo-RoPE with frozen-core LoRA SLEEP consolidation gated by Caelus local-horizon night and unsupervised phase-stratified dreaming replay beats Naive-Online-FT and SLEEP-Fixed24h-LRU on 5-cycle continual retention, catastrophic forgetting delta, and nocturnal sleep-gate safety.
null_baseline: Part A (3 seeds, 1,427,136 params each): Standard-RoPE (64-D token-step RoPE), Hybrid-Unix-Fourier-RoPE (32-D step + 32-D fixed UTC 24h/7d/365.25d), location-aware Hybrid-Unix-Fourier+LatLon (eliminating location gap with LMT=UTC+lon/15 and lat/lon), and minimal 20-line Hybrid-NOAA20-RoPE (solar-only formula, zero Moon/ephemeris). Part B (3 seeds, matched rank-16 LoRA 193,536 params, B=250): Naive-Online-FT, SLEEP-Fixed24h-LRU, Diag-SLEEP-GeoRoPE-LRU, SLEEP-Reservoir-Random (Vitter's Algorithm R uniform reservoir), and SLEEP-NOAA20-Stratified.
success_bar: Part A: 0-parameter difference across all 3 models; Hybrid-Dual-Geo-RoPE stays within 5 pp of Standard-RoPE on Task 1 (confirming no intra-turn collapse), achieves >= 95% on Task 2 (tying Hybrid-Unix-Fourier-RoPE and beating Standard-RoPE by >= 50 pp), beats Hybrid-Unix-Fourier-RoPE by >= 25 pp on OOD Task 3 (Oslo winter/summer solstices + NYC-to-Tokyo travel), and beats Hybrid-Unix-Fourier-RoPE on Task 4 multi-week non-aliasing while honestly reporting 30d trained-weight ties. Part B: SLEEP-Caelus-Circadian-Stratified achieves >= 80% mean retention across Cycles 1..5 (+>= 25 pp over SLEEP-Fixed24h-LRU), cuts catastrophic forgetting delta by >= 20 pp vs SLEEP-Fixed24h-LRU and >= 45 pp vs Naive-Online-FT, and achieves 100% local-horizon nocturnal sleep-gate safety (while honestly reporting recency-only C4+C5 plasticity trade-offs).
kill_criterion: If Hybrid-Dual-Geo-RoPE fails to beat Hybrid-Unix-Fourier-RoPE by >= 15 pp on OOD Task 3, drops more than 10 pp below Standard-RoPE on Task 1 intra-turn tracking, OR if SLEEP-Caelus-Circadian-Stratified fails to beat SLEEP-Fixed24h-LRU by >= 10 pp on final Cycle 1..5 mean retention accuracy.
